description: Find Walmart stores near a US ZIP (walmart.com) or Canadian postal code (domain 'ca'), nearest first: store_id, name, distance_miles, address, coordinates, hours. Use a store_id with delivery_zip on search_walmart or get_walmart_product (same domain) to target that store. 1 credit.

zipcode.description: 5-digit US ZIP, e.g. '50036', or Canadian postal code with domain 'ca', e.g. 'M5V 2T6'.

name: get_walmart_stores
